scope: Steps 5/6; protocol fixed before revised evaluation; retrospective verification
score: max(q05-y, y-q95, 0); conservative nonnegative variant, not signed CQR
scale: max(q95-q05, epsilon)^power, same definition on calibration and test
quantile: k=ceil((n_cal+1)*(1-alpha)); kth sorted score, positive infinity if k>n_cal
summary: subset means and sample SD over five seeds, paired adaptive-minus-exact differences; no pooling of repeated test engines as independent observations
coverage_success: report exact number of runs with empirical coverage >=0.90; no guarantee inferred from a mean
sampling_audit: reconstruct calibration endpoints with historical eligible-endpoint RNG and saved engine split; check official test final endpoints, padding, capped/uncapped targets and last-cycle operating regime
strata_interpretation: descriptive only, including empty strata; no conditional coverage guarantee or significance tests
selection: do not adjust endpoints, normalization power, alpha, or choose methods based on official test scores
known_limitation: calibration eligible endpoints require raw RUL 1..125; official test uses externally truncated final histories and can have raw RUL>125. Exchangeability is not established; width normalization does not repair the sampling design by itself
